fields.name: name
fields.description: Game name as we write it (the App Store name without the tagline).

fields.name: studio
fields.description: Developer shown on the App Store.

fields.name: released
fields.description: First release date on the US App Store.

fields.name: genre
fields.description: Main App Store category.

fields.name: ios_rating
fields.description: Average rating on the US App Store, exact to two decimals.

fields.name: ios_ratings
fields.description: Number of ratings on the US App Store.

fields.name: android_rating
fields.description: Average rating on the US Google Play store.

fields.name: android_ratings
fields.description: Number of ratings on the US Google Play store.

fields.name: android_downloads
fields.description: Download range shown by Google Play, for example 10M+. Blank when we could not match the game to a Google Play page.

fields.name: price_ios
fields.description: Price on the US App Store: Free, a dollar price, Free to try, Apple Arcade or Netflix membership.

fields.name: price_android
fields.description: Price on the US Google Play store.

fields.name: android_ads
fields.description: Whether the Google Play page shows the "Contains ads" label.

fields.name: android_iap
fields.description: Whether the Google Play page shows the "In-app purchases" label.

fields.name: ios_size_mb
fields.description: Download size on iPhone from Apple's iTunes Search API.

fields.name: ios_languages
fields.description: Number of languages listed on the App Store.

fields.name: ios_version
fields.description: Latest version number on the App Store.

fields.name: ios_last_update
fields.description: Date of the latest App Store update.

fields.name: age_rating
fields.description: Age rating on the US App Store.

fields.name: read_on
fields.description: Most recent date we read this game's store pages.

fields.name: app_store_url
fields.description: US App Store page.

fields.name: google_play_url
fields.description: US Google Play page.

fields.name: boltshorts_page
fields.description: This game's page on Boltshorts, with every number and how it compares.

fields.name: boltshorts_lists
fields.description: Boltshorts lists that rank this game.

fields.name: app_store_id
fields.description: Numeric App Store id. It never changes, so it is the key to join versions and other datasets.

fields.name: genres
fields.description: Every App Store category of the game, main one first, separated by semicolons.

fields.name: ios_min_version
fields.description: Oldest iOS version the current App Store build supports.

fields.name: ipad
fields.description: Whether the App Store lists iPad among the supported devices.

fields.name: ios_advisories
fields.description: Content descriptors behind the App Store age rating, for example "Loot Boxes" or "Infrequent/Mild Simulated Gambling".

fields.name: android_developer
fields.description: Developer name shown on Google Play.

fields.name: android_released
fields.description: Release date shown on Google Play.

fields.name: android_last_update
fields.description: Date of the latest update shown on Google Play.

fields.name: android_iap_range
fields.description: Price range per item that Google Play shows, for example "$0.99 - $99.99 per item".

fields.name: android_editors_choice
fields.description: Whether the Google Play page shows the Editors' Choice badge.

fields.name: chart_date
fields.description: Date of the App Store top charts in chart_positions.

fields.name: chart_positions
fields.description: Positions in the US App Store top 100 charts for iPhone on chart_date, as chart/category/rank, separated by semicolons. Categories are App Store game genres; "Games" is the chart of all games.

fields.name: source_set
fields.description: "boltshorts-lists" for a game on one of our lists, "app-store-charts" for a game that was in a US App Store top chart for games when we read them, "same-studio" for another game with 1,000+ US App Store ratings from a studio already in the table.
